_about: Census-people basis store for the 2001 federal election frame — the measured 2001-census lane joined to its own election (no intercensal blend: census night sat ~3 months before election day; the SEIFA pcti side classes this election measured-only too, seifa-src/div-interp.json). The people-smallest-area is a 2001-census collection district (ASGC 2001 CD): a booth's demo block is the 2001 Basic Community Profile counts of the CD its venue stands in — the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters. The venue CD is computed three-tiered (data/booth-seifa-2001.json carries coordinate provenance, not CD codes): 'gpp 2004' rows inherit the 2004 store's own 2001-CD code for the same premises (counts.boothsCdInherit2004); other coorded rows are pointed into the 2001 CD polygons (counts.boothsCdPip, misses counts.boothsCdPipMiss); suburb-tier venues (a suburb centroid can span many CDs) and coordinate-less rows carry demo:null (counts.boothsSuburbTier / boothsNoCoords — no number from a dishonest join). A division's row is the exact 2001-BCP sum over the CDs whole-allocated to its 2001-election division (seifa-src/cd-2001-ced-2001set.json), real headcounts, never vote-weighted pseudo-populations. The 2001 BCP ships as ~35,000 per-CD spreadsheets (no bulk 2001 datapack on abs.gov.au; source is the archive.org mirror of the ABS CDATA-era product), tallied per CD into an extraction table by extract-bcp-2001-tally.py, and overseas visitors ride their own row inside several 2001 tables' totals and are subtracted so every lane is the as-enumerated resident count the GCP-era products take. The six new People lanes ride the 2001 BCP's own tables identically to the 2004-election lane: B 10's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys, No-religion leading; the orth lane sums the edition's two "Orthodox"/"Oriental Christian" rows) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons-ex-overseas basis, B 12's year-12-or-less over the printed stated schooling levels (its "Still at school" row kept out of the basis to hold the GCP-era frame), B 01's total Indigenous persons over persons ex-overseas (the 2001 product publishes no Indigenous-status-not-stated row, so the lane's basis is persons ex-overseas — the share runs a few per cent relative under the later editions' ex-not-stated basis), B 19's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys, owned-with-mortgage leading; the 2001 print has no grand-total column, its rented total riding its own printed column) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis, B 17's one-parent share of families, and the under-15 share of the stated ages; B 30's family-income x type grid and B 31's household grid feed the income lanes through the shared income engine identically to the 2004-election lane (loinc the adult share below the incomeCuts record's national 25th-percentile weekly cut in 2001 dollars, hiinc the adult share in the $2,000-or-more top band — this edition's hi edge — incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income on the household basis). Two balance-area CDs carry a truncated workbook (no demographic tables) and count people but share no lanes (counts.cdsShortTable/personsShortTable — the not-stated doctrine over whole tables). Anglophone-age-language-foreign-born-uni shares mirror the 2004-election lane's (which mirrors d13's); OCCUPATION is the ASCO classification (pre-ANZSCO): blue-collar maps {Tradespersons, Intermediate Production & Transport, Labourers} onto the ANZSCO 3/7/8 lane (broadly comparable per ABS, the named definitional wobble). Birthplace countries ride cobKeys/cob (the /map/ Born-overseas country menu: whole-UK leading as eng leads the 2021-era menu, then the era's eight, all read from the same B 06 table).

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2001 Census Basic Community Profile, per-CD xlsx (archive.org mirror of the CDATA-era CD product, identifier 2001-bcp-cd-00_aus)
sourceUrls.venueInherit: data/booth-seifa-2004.json (the 2001-CD geo lane the 'gpp 2004' venues inherit)
sourceUrls.gpkg: dl/asgc2001.gpkg (ABS 2001 ASGC digital boundaries — the CD polygons and the 2001-edition CED layer both)

deliveryBasis: venue-CD join per booth (inherit lane: the 2004 seifa store's own 2001-CD geo for the same premises; point-in-polygon of the venue's derived coordinates otherwise; suburb-tier and coordinate-less rows null); exact CD sum per division (cd-2001-ced-2001set)
